a.xlink:title: Updates which card is currently hovered based on scene coordinates.
Topmost card at a scene position, without side effects.
Finds the topmost card in a given zone, considering attachments and Z-order.
Finds the topmost card zone under the cursor.
Activates hover state and escapes the card from its clip container so hover scaling is visible beyond...
Restores every lifted ancestor to its pre-hover Z-value and drops the chain.
Deactivates hover state and restores the card to its clip container.
What zooms the hovered card (a HoverPanelTrigger value). Zoom and panel triggers are independent.
Shows the hover outline and stacking lift, plus the historical 1.1x hover scale whenever no zoom trig...
Finds the SelectZone that owns a card, regardless of whether the card is parented to the zone directl...
Emitted when the hover zoom changes this card's scene footprint.
Emitted when the hover shrink-out animation runs to completion while unhovered.
Repaints the zones that dodge the zoomed card when its footprint moves.
Settles a finished shrink-out: clip container and ancestor lift restore.
Asks the scene to dismiss the panel before a modal dialog opens.
Fades the card out under the hover panel, or back in when it closes.
